facts.fact: Morocco's DGI says SIMPL teleservices let taxpayers declare and pay taxes electronically, with 12,304,943 tele-payments in 2025.
The DGI 2025 activity report, as reported by le360, puts the share of tax revenue paid by tele-payment at 91.4% in 2025 (91.2% in 2024).

MAR.note: Customs duties not stated, so no fact for the main aspect.

facts.fact: The DGI says SIMPL lets taxpayers file returns online, with 5,031,004 e-filed returns in 2025.
The DGI says SIMPL lets taxpayers pay taxes electronically, with 91.4% of tax revenue tele-paid in 2025.

MAR.note: Mandatory filing or share of returns filed online not stated.
